mechanism.claim: When the completed one-hour Binance premium-index levels of six liquid alt perpetuals share one sign and their cross-sectional median is unusually far from its causal baseline, leveraged crowding is market-wide rather than BTC-specific. During elevated BTC variation, fade that common alt premium crowding in BTC for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the cross-sectional median alt premium residual
mechanism.why_distinct: Existing cross-alt leverage candidates use funding settlements or price, flow, turnover, and range geometry. Existing premium candidates use BTCUSDT alone. HVCAPCR uses the contemporaneous cross-sectional median of six alt-only premium-index levels, with no alt return, BTC direction, funding value, OI, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must occupy its causal upper 35% while absolute cross-alt premium crowding enters its upper 20%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: hourly false-to-true cross-alt premium-crowding onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.premium_hour: 60 exact bars_binance_premium one-minute closes [T-1h,T) per alt; arithmetic mean per symbol; finite signed values
features.sign_concordance: all six hourly premium means strict nonzero and one common sign
features.cross_alt_median: median of six hourly premium means
features.causal_baseline: median of at most 720 strictly prior source-valid hourly cross-alt medians; minimum 672; current excluded
features.residual: cross-alt median minus causal baseline, strict nonzero and same sign as all six premium means
features.residual_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute residual over the same causal history; rank at least 0.80
features.btc_variation: sum squared log(close/open) over exact 1440 BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-24h,T)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 720 prior source-valid hours, minimum 672, current excluded; rank at least 0.65
features.trigger: false-to-true onset versus previous consecutive source-valid hour
features.invalid: missing, duplicate, nonfinite premium; incomplete/nonpositive/incoherent BTC OHLC; sign disagreement; no imputation

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable-then-adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no symbol, premium aggregation, concordance, baseline, history, rank, variation, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
